speaker: Doctor
text: That is good news; your blood counts are normal, which rules out many systemic infections. However, given your recent hiking and camping, have you noticed any redness, swelling, or warmth in the legs of the exposed areas?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Weakness and fatigue. I also have Mild diplopia.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis.

The combination of progressive weakness, fatigue, and specifically the new symptom of mild diplopia (double vision) in a young woman points strongly toward a neuromuscular junction disorder. Since your blood work was normal and you lack signs of recent infection or trauma, we can rule out common infectious causes. Would you agree that your leg weakness is symmetric, and do you experience any drooping of your eyelids?
